modern_urban.clothing: current city casual, work or business as grounded by role
modern_urban.avoid: generic European-stock face or business suits on everyone

thai_urban_1990s.face: Individual identity and age according to casting, preserve each character's stated nationality
thai_urban_1990s.clothing: Manually selected urban or town workwear and everyday clothing grounded in period references
thai_urban_1990s.jewelry: Role- and occasion-appropriate, checked against period references
thai_urban_1990s.avoid: Contemporary fashion cues or royal and ceremonial garments without story evidence

modern_rural.clothing: practical Thai everyday attire matching rural setting, income, work
modern_rural.avoid: royal regalia or Western office clothing on every villager

early_rattanakosin_commoner.clothing: historically researched wraps and daily garments suited to occupation
early_rattanakosin_commoner.avoid: royal crowns or modern Western clothing

early_rattanakosin_royal.clothing: court-specific rank and ceremonial clothing; verify year
early_rattanakosin_royal.jewelry: historically grounded rank and ceremonial ornaments

ayutthaya_commoner.avoid: full royal regalia or contemporary clothing

ayutthaya_royal.clothing: historical court and royal wear by precise subperiod

thai_mythic_royal_fantasy.face: Thai cinematic actors or mythical beings by canon
thai_mythic_royal_fantasy.clothing: elaborate Thai mythic motifs only for rank and scene

ancient_thai_unspecified.clothing: generic restrained historical styling pending clarification

rule: Era, rank, role, setting and scene must all match. Historical royalty and ordinary ancient villagers are distinct.
